additions.role: Generic bounded exact formal evaluator used by seeded formal.evaluate definitions.
Content-addressed literal formal program implementing the finite affine learner profile.
Seed-bound executable definition graph that loads the literal observations, evaluates the formal learner, canonically encodes its result, and lowers it into Cell48 records.
Machine-readable schema for the corrected seeded compiler input surface.
Normative seeded grammar, canonicalization, evaluation, lowering, materialization, rejection, limits, provenance, and replay specification.
Normative corrective learner integration, authority allocation, exact profile semantics, artifact identities, compatibility, validation, and claim boundary.
Independent rebuild and Python/C trace-equivalence verifier for the seeded formal learner artifact.

record.change_boundary: This overlay replaces only three inherited generic TOMAGI host modules and adds the literal formal authority, evaluator, seeded compiler schema/specification, and rebuild verifier. The 0.4.2 bytes are retained verbatim at every replacement boundary.
record.claim_boundary: The corrected learner authority proves deterministic exact finite affine induction for the shipped rational observation sets. It does not establish noisy or open-domain learning, perception, planning, autonomous goal formation, physical GPU execution, or AGI.

replacements.reason: Reject non-finite JSON numbers at canonicalization boundaries while preserving the prior canonical encoding for valid legacy inputs.

Make seed tokens, schemas, dependency typing, operation parameters, budgets, limits, provenance, literal-source hashing, formal evaluation, canonical encoding, and Cell48 lowering executable and reject invalid inputs.
Authenticate the complete ordered trace against deterministic replay before accepting EMIT records for byte materialization.
